meta.title: Final Twilight
meta.description: The judgment of the gods is nigh.

units.rawText: <color=red>In the crumbling Neural Cloud Sector.</color>
units.displayText: In the crumbling Neural Cloud Sector.

spans.text: In the crumbling Neural Cloud Sector.

units.rawText: Eosphorus raises his hand to summon more starlight when he suddenly freezes in place, as though he's realized something.
units.displayText: Eosphorus raises his hand to summon more starlight when he suddenly freezes in place, as though he's realized something.

spans.text: Eosphorus raises his hand to summon more starlight when he suddenly freezes in place, as though he's realized something.

units.rawText: ...What's wrong?
units.displayText: ...What's wrong?

spans.text: ...What's wrong?

units.rawText: The operands around him slowly ripple, as though they're trembling and resonating with some tremendous surge of emotion.
units.displayText: The operands around him slowly ripple, as though they're trembling and resonating with some tremendous surge of emotion.

spans.text: The operands around him slowly ripple, as though they're trembling and resonating with some tremendous surge of emotion.

units.rawText: Eosphorus slowly touches his hand to his chest as he feels his ego dissipate. Tears stream from the corners of his eyes.
units.displayText: Eosphorus slowly touches his hand to his chest as he feels his ego dissipate. Tears stream from the corners of his eyes.

spans.text: Eosphorus slowly touches his hand to his chest as he feels his ego dissipate. Tears stream from the corners of his eyes.

units.rawText: <color=orange>...So those neural fragments... still vanished in the end?</color>
units.displayText: ...So those neural fragments... still vanished in the end?

spans.text: ...So those neural fragments... still vanished in the end?

units.rawText: He closes his eyes, and the operands around him suddenly flare with a blinding light that almost completely obscures his form.
units.displayText: He closes his eyes, and the operands around him suddenly flare with a blinding light that almost completely obscures his form.

spans.text: He closes his eyes, and the operands around him suddenly flare with a blinding light that almost completely obscures his form.

units.rawText: Eosphorus' calm voice speaks from inside the light.
units.displayText: Eosphorus' calm voice speaks from inside the light.

spans.text: Eosphorus' calm voice speaks from inside the light.

units.rawText: My obsession is lost. My goal means nothing. What I seek no longer matters.
units.displayText: My obsession is lost. My goal means nothing. What I seek no longer matters.

spans.text: My obsession is lost. My goal means nothing. What I seek no longer matters.

units.rawText: My past means nothing, my future means nothing, and this world means nothing.
units.displayText: My past means nothing, my future means nothing, and this world means nothing.

spans.text: My past means nothing, my future means nothing, and this world means nothing.

units.rawText: <color=red>In that case, then may everything end here with me.</color>
units.displayText: In that case, then may everything end here with me.

spans.text: In that case, then may everything end here with me.

units.rawText: As Eosphorus finishes speaking, the collapsing sector lurches and the operands from all around rush toward the light.
units.displayText: As Eosphorus finishes speaking, the collapsing sector lurches and the operands from all around rush toward the light.

spans.text: As Eosphorus finishes speaking, the collapsing sector lurches and the operands from all around rush toward the light.

units.rawText: Just look at the scale of these operand fluctuations... Is he burning himself up?!
units.displayText: Just look at the scale of these operand fluctuations... Is he burning himself up?!

spans.text: Just look at the scale of these operand fluctuations... Is he burning himself up?!

units.rawText: No, it's not just himself, it's also the operands he was storing up for this moment, and all the power from the Entropy...
units.displayText: No, it's not just himself, it's also the operands he was storing up for this moment, and all the power from the Entropy...

spans.text: No, it's not just himself, it's also the operands he was storing up for this moment, and all the power from the Entropy...

units.rawText: Is he nuts? Has he given up on going to reality?
units.displayText: Is he nuts? Has he given up on going to reality?

spans.text: Is he nuts? Has he given up on going to reality?

units.rawText: It seems the Professor's efforts in his neural cloud have borne fruit... In any case, we can't let him take Magrasea with him; the Professor's still in there!
units.displayText: It seems the Professor's efforts in his neural cloud have borne fruit... In any case, we can't let him take Magrasea with him; the Professor's still in there!

spans.text: It seems the Professor's efforts in his neural cloud have borne fruit... In any case, we can't let him take Magrasea with him; the Professor's still in there!

units.rawText: Magrasea is in a highly unstable condition right now. We need to take him out ASAP!
units.displayText: Magrasea is in a highly unstable condition right now. We need to take him out ASAP!

spans.text: Magrasea is in a highly unstable condition right now. We need to take him out ASAP!

units.rawText: As the power flows into him, the light fades and what was once a calm, indifferent Sanctifier is gone, replaced by a demon god looking down upon the world.
units.displayText: As the power flows into him, the light fades and what was once a calm, indifferent Sanctifier is gone, replaced by a demon god looking down upon the world.

spans.text: As the power flows into him, the light fades and what was once a calm, indifferent Sanctifier is gone, replaced by a demon god looking down upon the world.

units.rawText: Still, even in the face of hell incarnate, not a single person before him backs down.
units.displayText: Still, even in the face of hell incarnate, not a single person before him backs down.

spans.text: Still, even in the face of hell incarnate, not a single person before him backs down.

units.rawText: <size=40>We won't let you get your way!</size>
units.displayText: We won't let you get your way!

spans.text: We won't let you get your way!
